entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought. This whole process is a joke. I want my money back, now.
I can certainly help you with that. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
It's Mark Peterson, order number VF78910. I've had it with this company. If this isn't sorted out in five minutes, I'm leaving a one-star review everywhere I can find.
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the Trail Helmet. To make sure I'm assisting you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference? The color is hideous, it's nothing like the picture online! The box is unopened, it's just been sitting here. I shouldn't have to justify wanting my money back for a product I don't want.

I understand completely. Sometimes the color can look different depending on screen settings. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities, so let's get this sorted for you. Let me just review the return policy for your helmet.
You'd better. Don't try to give me some runaround about a 10-day policy or something. I'll just talk to your manager right now and save us both the time.

I appreciate your patience, Mark. I'm just checking the details... Okay, I've confirmed it. I see your helmet was delivered 56 days ago. Our policy for standard items like this allows for returns within 90 days. You are well within the timeframe.
Oh. So you're actually approving it? No games?

Yes, of course. Since the box is unopened, it meets the 'original condition' requirement. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Do you still have access to that one?
...Yeah, I do. So I just print it and send the helmet back?

That's correct. Just attach the label to the shipping box and drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Fine. Make sure that email comes through.
It has just been sent. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Mark?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
